people.narrativeText: Ellis Ward is a wholly fictional home-support worker associated with the invented provider DEMO-ADL-SUPPORT-01. Separate extracts record an allocated support role for Resident A in Marion and Resident B in Oaklands Park. A directory associates a service account with that allocation, but the retained outward message has not been independently attributed to its author. Resident B permitted a limited transport enquiry; no equivalent authority for Resident A is supplied. Ellis is a documentary comparison contact, not an identified offender or financial helper.

people.narrativeText: Rowan Hale is a wholly fictional outside contact named in a volunteered directory entry for a community-transport enquiry. A retained exchange includes a corresponding account label, while independent account ownership and message authorship remain unverified. Rowan supplies a possible enquiry context for Resident B, but cannot explain Resident A’s label in the retained text. No source places Rowan at a dwelling or connects Rowan with spending, entry or missing property. This is contextual document review, not an allegation of responsibility.

posts.text: [Fictional community post] Someone close to me has raised a concern about an approach to their home. They rely on help and are now wondering who knows their private circumstances. They want to ask questions without losing that help. Where can they start privately? Please do not name anyone or share addresses.
posts.basis: A separately authored private follow-up in EV-ADL-H15 supplies ACI-V2-2026-0001 and permission to record the concern. Public wording alone identifies neither resident nor event.

posts.text: [Fictional community post] I agreed to help arranging transport, but that was not permission to share everything about me. After an unfamiliar approach to my home I want the limits of that permission recorded. I cannot say that the two things are connected.
posts.basis: A separately authored private clarification in EV-ADL-H16 supplies ACI-V2-2026-0002. Limited transport permission is a comparison context, not corroboration of a visitor or a shared cause.
